meta.name: explore-run
meta.description: Rigor Improve / Rigor Explore run leaf skill for bounded exploratory evidence in deep learning research repositories. Use when the researcher explicitly authorizes exploratory runs such as small-subset validation, short-cycle guess-and-check, batch sweeps, idle-GPU search, or quick transfer-learning trials, with fair-comparison caveats and no-overclaim summaries in `explore_outputs/`. Do not use for end-to-end exploration orchestration on top of `current_research`, trusted baseline execution, conservative training verification, default routing, verified SOTA claims, or implicit experimentation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 运行授权范围内的探索性深度学习实验并产出诚实摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在做深度学习研究,需要快速验证实验猜想
copy.tagline_en: Run bounded exploratory deep learning experiments and produce honest summaries
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a deep learning researcher wanting quick small-scale validation runs

howto.what: 在深度学习仓库中规划有边界的探索性实验:先做小规模、短周期的候选运行,排序候选方案,标记结果为有限证据并说明比较是否公平,输出到 explore_outputs/ 的五个文件中。
howto.when: 当研究人员明确授权探索性运行,或任务属于小规模子集验证、短周期训练探针、批量扫描等需要给候选方案排序的场景时触发。

say.text: 规划小规模子集验证,给候选方案排序。
做一次短周期训练探针,对比两个变体。
say.note: 会把手动执行交给其他技能,并标注结果有限。

say.text: 在空闲 GPU 上做批量扫描,输出可比较性报告。
say.note: 除非明确给权重,否则按保守默认排序。

howto.what_en: Plans bounded exploratory runs in deep learning repos: prefers small-subset/short-cycle checks, ranks candidates, labels results as limited evidence, flags unfair comparisons, and writes reports to explore_outputs/.
howto.when_en: Triggered when exploratory runs are explicitly authorized, or the task is small-subset validation, short-cycle probes, or batch sweeps that need candidate ranking. Not for trusted baselines or repo setup.

say_en.text: Plan a small-subset validation and rank the candidate options.
say_en.note: Writes plan and ranking files under explore_outputs/.

say_en.text: Run a short-cycle training probe comparing two variants.
say_en.note: Hands off execution to other skills and marks results as limited.

say_en.text: Do a batch sweep on idle GPUs and output a comparability report.
say_en.note: Uses conservative default weights unless you give explicit ones.
